summary: Empty the colour-literal allowlist directory by directory: replace raw literals with src/index.css tokens, and stop the ratchet reading prose as colour

coordination.notes: Continues Lane I from the session that landed I1 and I2 rather than starting a rival ratchet: tools/color-token-test.mjs and its allowlist are that session's files and are extended in place. Lane D is editing src/App.tsx and moving panels between src/components directories concurrently; the allowlist is keyed on {file, literal, count}, so a moved file changes its key and the ratchet says so on rebase - rebased and re-run after each. The conflict matrix reserves RoomBackdrop.tsx and RoomScene.tsx to `rewrite/remove-2d` until C7 is decided; C7 is [x] as of 5 Sep, and `git diff --stat origin/main...origin/rewrite/remove-2d -- src/components/room/` shows that branch deleting RoomBackdrop.tsx outright, which is recorded in the I4 handling rather than guessed at.
